method_notes:
Built 2026-09-30 by the roster agent. 744 institutions from 5 accreditor lists (JAZA/WAZA skipped per brief).
LISTS: AZA inst-status read in the browser (curl 403); 254 entries = 240 accredited institutions + 14 Accredited Related Facilities. ARFs are excluded (not zoos/aquariums; most not open to the public). The R2 snapshot is a pipe-delimited extraction of the page. Normalised on extraction: "Houston Zoo, Inc. Houston" comma; Bermuda/Temaikèn/Cali town fields; ® removed. CAZA: curl, 23 institutions. Reptilia Zoo (3 locations) is expanded to Vaughan/Whitby/London. Toronto, Calgary, Assiniboine and Granby are on AZA but not on the current CAZA list. EAZA: page-data.json, 453 records; kept Full member, Full Accredited Member, Temporary member and Conditional Member (334). Excluded: Associates, Candidates, Corporate, and the 1 "Temporary Member under construction". The type is in accreditation_detail.EAZA.eaza_membership, so the 6 Conditional members can be filtered out. BIAZA: members/all is now PUBLIC (no login), 127 listed; the 10 '(Provisional Member)' are excluded, as are 3 college teaching collections and World Museum Liverpool. So every UK/IE place is checked against BIAZA directly. EAZA-only UK/IE (10): Birdland Park and Gardens; Cotswold Wildlife Park; Fife Zoo; Howletts Wild Animal Park; Paradise Park; Port Lympne Wild Animal Park; Waddesdon Manor Aviary; Woodside Wildlife Park; Dingle Oceanworld Aquarium; Emerald Park. ZAA: the homepage 'Find ZAA-accredited' link (Locate.aspx) is 404; the nav 'Find ZAA-Accredited Members' page (Find.aspx) was read in the browser. It still has NO South Australia section (no Adelaide Zoo or Monarto Safari Park anywhere in the page HTML) and lists NT twice. adelaide-zoo and monarto-safari-park (existing ids) are therefore NOT in the roster (unconfirmable, no other accreditation). Excluded from ZAA: DPI NSW, Priam Psittaculture Centre, Kanyana, Perth Wildlife Hospital, WA Wildlife, Melbourne Museum, Otago Museum, Dunedin Botanic Garden, Yanchep National Park, Gibbs Wildlife Conservancy. 'Mandai Wildlife Group' (International Member) is expanded to Singapore Zoo, Night Safari, River Wonders and Bird Paradise. All 39 exclusions with reasons: cache_local/roster/excluded.json.
MERGE/IDs: rows were resolved to Wikidata (wbsearchentities + CirrusSearch full-text, scored on P31 zoo/aquarium class + P17 country + P856 domain + label overlap; backoff on 429/maxlag), merged across bodies by Q-id, and 142 weak matches were reviewed by hand (cache_local/roster/overrides.py). Existing out_*.json ids are reused when the Q-id or name+country matches (100 reused, incl. cerza). cerza was re-linked by hand to the EAZA row 'Centre d'Etudes et de Recherche Zoologiques Augeron - CERZA'. Ids are ASCII kebab slugs (diacritics folded, e.g. ı->i).
FIELDS: accreditation = array of bodies; accreditation_source = parallel array of list URLs; accreditation_detail has the list's own name per body plus AZA accredited_through / EAZA membership type. lat/lng come only from Wikidata P625 (coord_source); 51 institutions have no confident Wikidata item and 15 have an item without P625. Those coords are null, and an OSM lookup is needed before use. town/region come from the accreditor list where it gives them (AZA town/state, BIAZA county/address, CAZA address, ZAA state), otherwise from the Wikidata P131 chain (town = first P131, region = top admin below country), so some 'town' values are districts. type is a heuristic (safari in name or P31 safari park -> safari_park; zoo/tierpark words -> zoo; aquarium words or P31 public aquarium -> aquarium). Science centres and museums accredited by AZA are typed zoo/aquarium by best fit. url comes from the list (EAZA/BIAZA/CAZA), else the existing record, else Wikidata P856.
SWEEP REGIONS: US-West = WA OR CA NV ID MT WY UT CO AZ NM AK HI; US-Central = ND SD NE KS OK TX MN IA MO AR LA WI IL; US-East = the rest. Canada+LatAm includes BM, BS and GF. UK+IE includes JE, IM and GI. The French Caribbean zoos (Guadeloupe, Martinique) are ISO FR in EAZA and so fall in FR+ES+PT+IT+rest-of-Europe. TR, GE, RO and the Baltics are rest-of-Europe. IL, AE, KW, KZ, HK, KR, SG, AU, NZ and PG are Oceania+Asia+Africa.
